welcome.title: Welcome to
welcome.subtitle: LuminousChenXi AI Companion Platform
welcome.agreementDesc: Before using LuomiNest, please read and agree to the key points below. You can open the links to read the full documents.

agreePoint.agreement: This agreement defines the rights and obligations between you and the development team regarding the use of this app.
agreePoint.localFirst: Local-first: conversations, memory and preferences are stored on this machine by default and are not uploaded to LuomiNest servers.
agreePoint.thirdParty: After configuring third-party model services, conversations are transmitted and processed under their privacy policies.

welcome.agreeTermsPrefix: I have read and agree to the
welcome.agreePrivacyPrefix: I have read and agree to the
welcome.agreementGateHint: As required by law, you must agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before using LuomiNest.
welcome.featAgentDesc: Collaborate with multiple AI agents seamlessly
welcome.featWorkflowDesc: Design and automate complex task pipelines
welcome.featBrowserDesc: Let AI navigate and operate web pages for you
welcome.loginDesc: Pick a way to continue, or skip for now — you can always sign in later in Settings.
welcome.passportHint: Sign in with the Chenxi Passport to use cloud model quota, the cloud model catalog and cross-device preference sync. Device authorization (Device Flow) is used, so no password is entered in this app.
welcome.passportAlready: The Passport is already signed in on this machine. Continue to proceed.
welcome.passportPendingHint: Device authorization started. Confirm the sign-in on the authorization page opened in your browser, or open it manually and enter the following user code:
welcome.passportWaiting: Waiting for authorization, continuing automatically once confirmed...
welcome.passportError: Passport sign-in failed. Check your network and try again.
welcome.loginLaterHint: Signing in is not required for local features. You can sign in anytime in Settings → Passport / Sign In.
welcome.loginSkipDesc: You can use all local features without signing in. Preferences and conversations stay on this machine.
welcome.tourDesc: A few highlights of the features you will use most (click the dots to jump).

tour.chatDesc: Chat with AI with streaming replies across multiple model providers; conversations are stored locally and searchable anytime.
tour.avatarDesc: Dress your AI companion in Live2D / VRM / PixelPet avatars with custom motions and interactions.
tour.groupDesc: Assemble multiple agents into group chats in the conversation space and let different roles collaborate on one topic.
tour.browserDesc: The built-in browser lets AI research and operate web pages for you; browsing data stays on this machine.
tour.memoryDesc: Key facts are distilled from conversations into long-term memory, so your companion knows you better.
tour.smartHomeDesc: Connect smart-home scenarios and control your devices and automation plans with natural language.

welcome.aiModelDesc: Configure your first AI model provider to get started
welcome.aiModelNoProviders: No providers yet. Add one to get started.
welcome.aiModelSkipHint: You can configure models later in Settings
welcome.accountDesc: Create a local account for identity and preferences, or do it later in Settings
welcome.accountDisplayNameHint: Leave empty to use the username
welcome.accountSkipHint: All features work without an account. Create one later in Settings → Sign In
welcome.readyDesc: LuomiNest is ready to go. Let's start your journey.
welcome.agreePrefix: I have read and agree to the
welcome.termsLocalBody: Conversations, memory and preferences are stored on this machine by default and are not uploaded to LuomiNest servers.
welcome.termsAccountBody: The local account is only for identity and access control; your password is stored encrypted. You can also use the app without an account.
welcome.termsThirdpartyBody: After configuring third-party model providers (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), conversations are transmitted and processed under their privacy policies. API keys are only used to connect to the services you configure.
welcome.termsLicenseBody: This software is released under its open-source license, see Settings → Project References. AI-generated content may be inaccurate; use your own judgment.
